title: GTA6获98分史上最高评价 母公司股价大涨
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Today, Tate's who shares are absolutely soaring, up more than 7%, as the company prepares to release the highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto 6.
segments.zh: 今天，Tate's的股价大幅上涨，涨幅超过7%，因为公司准备发布备受期待的《侠盗猎车手6》。

segments.en: Tomorrow, the early reviews are overwhelmingly positive.
segments.zh: 明天，早期评测结果 overwhelmingly 积极。

segments.en: Our own Jason Shryer, calling it, quote, a masterpiece joining us now, Bloomberg Cecilia de Anastasio, covering all things video games, and like,
segments.zh: 我们自己的Jason Shryer称其为“杰作”，现在加入我们的是彭博社的Cecilia de Anastasio，她报道所有游戏相关的内容，而且，

segments.en: it seems real. The game, and you and I have not yet had a chance to play, but it's that good.
segments.zh: 看起来是真的。这款游戏，你和我还没有机会玩，但它就是那么好。

segments.en: Everyone's calling it a masterpiece. It has a 98 out of 100 score on Metacritic.
segments.zh: 大家都称它为杰作。它在Metacritic上的评分是98分（满分100）。

segments.en: It's one of the highest-reviewed games of all time. You know this industry, right?
segments.zh: 这是有史以来评价最高的游戏之一。你了解这个行业，对吧？

segments.en: Like, how normal is that? You know, and how it works. People get that early access.
segments.zh: 这有多正常？你知道它是怎么运作的。人们会获得早期访问权限。

segments.en: They play... Jason played for like 45 hours.
segments.zh: 他们玩……Jason玩了大约45个小时。

segments.en: Some reviewers played for more than 100. Okay, so these are real reviews with real enthusiasm based on real gameplay.
segments.zh: 一些评测者玩了超过100小时。所以这些是真实的评测，基于真实游戏体验的真实热情。

segments.en: 100%. And the thing about Grand Theft Auto 6, it took eight years, 4,700 people to develop.
segments.zh: 100%。关于《侠盗猎车手6》，它花了八年时间，4700人参与开发。

segments.en: Some people estimate it cost more than a billion dollars to make.
segments.zh: 有人估计制作成本超过十亿美元。

segments.en: And it had two delays. And so the anticipation's been building, and it seems like the game really, really delivers as well.
segments.zh: 它经历了两次延期。所以期待值一直在累积，而游戏似乎也确实不负众望。

segments.en: It's going to be available on PlayStation, on Xbox platforms.
It's going to be $80. $80. I mean, how do people feel about that going into it?
segments.zh: 售价将是80美元。80美元。大家对此怎么看？

segments.en: Video games cost $60 since I was a kid.
segments.zh: 从我小时候起，电子游戏就一直卖60美元。
